up: Retrieve the first 1000 rows of IC50 activities for the human target CHEMBL1743124 (solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 2B1). Output assay.chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id, molecule_structures.canonical_smiles, compound_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, and activities.pchembl_value. Filter activities to have standard_type='IC50', activities.standard_relation='=' (exact value), activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL, and activities.doc_id linked to assays via assay.chembl_id = activities.assay_chembl_id. Join activities to assays on activity.assay_id = assay.assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on assay.tid = target_dictionary.tid, and activities to compound_structures and compound_dictionary via activity.molecule_chembl_id = compound_structures.molecule_chembl_id = compound_dictionary.chembl_id. Order results by compound_dictionary.chembl_id ASC, assay.chembl_id ASC. Return exactly these columns without additional text.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.assay_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       td.target_type,
       td.tax_id,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       cd.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       a.standard_type,
       a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_dictionary cd ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cd.chembl_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND td.pref_name = 'Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 2B1'
ORDER BY cd.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;

  FROM target_dictionary
  WHERE pref_name = 'Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 2B1'

),

JOIN target_tid tt ON ass.tid = tt.tid
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid

ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC
